about: The ontologist's folds for organisers (work/42), on top of data/organisers.json (dev.2's canonical names, work/23): spellings that are the same organisation, and an organisation that is a programme of another (part_of). Organisations only, never a private person; no contact details. An entry with "hold" is withheld: its events show as by an independent organiser, with no name and no page, until a researcher confirms at its public page that it is an organisation.
